title: The French Revolution
subtitle: Rise of Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity
subject: Social Science (History)
author: Shine Academy EduOS
learning_outcomes: Understand the social, economic, and political conditions of France before the revolution.
Analyze the causes that led to the outbreak of the French Revolution.
Chronicle the key events of the revolution.
Evaluate the impact of the French Revolution on France and the world.
Appreciate the legacy of Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity.

ai_context.learning_goal: Student should deeply understand the systemic inequalities in 18th century France and how they culminated in a revolution that reshaped modern democratic ideals.
common_misconceptions: The revolution was only caused by the poor starving.
The Reign of Terror was the entirety of the revolution.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with the Estates system, ask: 'Imagine if you had to pay all the taxes for your town while the richest people paid nothing. How would you feel?'
